about: Win conditions (SPEC §2; v214 Victory Meter v59). Capture mode: each side starts with `tickets` (setup may set its own); at every side's turn start (victory settlement) the side behind on victory points loses bleed_by_vp_lead[lead] (lead 3+ uses the last), +1 per momentum_every consecutive settlements with the same leader (a shrinking lead halves the streak, a new leader resets it); at VP parity a resource-control gap of parity.control_gap (point weights) bleeds parity.bleed from the weaker side. 0 tickets loses; both at 0: more VPs wins (blue on a tie). Annihilation mode: a side with no units left that cannot field a new one (nothing it can afford within the population cap) loses; with a round cap, after that round the higher surviving unit value wins, equal is a draw.
